consequence.statement: A ScrapeConfig whose spec.ovhcloudSDConfigs[].service is set to a value other than "DedicatedServer" or "VPS" is rejected by the API server, since the field is now enum-constrained where it previously had no such restriction.
consequence.remediation: Set spec.ovhcloudSDConfigs[].service to one of the allowed values "DedicatedServer" or "VPS" (or remove the ovhcloud SD config) before applying or updating ScrapeConfig resources against the new release.

assertion.statement: In the monitoring.coreos.com/v1alpha1 schema of scrapeconfigs.monitoring.coreos.com, the allowed values of spec.ovhcloudSDConfigs[].service changed: no enum values were removed and \"DedicatedServer\" and \"VPS\" were added, so the field is now restricted to those two values and any other value is rejected by the API server.
